hints: The given prefix may already be invalid if a closing bracket appears before its matching opening bracket.
Let the remaining length be r and current balance be b; the rest must contain (r-b)/2 opening brackets.
Count completions with a ballot/Catalan prefix constraint, and return zero if parity or balance makes completion impossible.
analogy: After the fixed prefix, count balanced endings that never let the closing count get ahead.
example: For prefix '(' and total length 2, balance 1, one character remains and must be ')', so there is one completion.
algorithm: Validate the prefix balance. Let r=n-prefixLength and b=opens-closes; if b>r or (r-b) is odd return 0. Set opensNeeded=(r-b)/2 and use the ballot count C(r,opensNeeded)-C(r,opensNeeded-1), modulo 1e9+7.
correctness: The ballot difference counts suffixes with enough opens to offset the existing balance at every prefix and end at balance zero; invalid parity/balance cannot be repaired.
complexity: O(n) preprocessing and O(1) query; O(n) space.
